title: Name Audit Service for Clients
summary: Productize the name vetting automation as a standalone service offering for external clients seeking business name validation
findings: The name-vetting.js automation provides significant value beyond internal DBA naming. Many startups, entrepreneurs, and agencies need comprehensive name validation but lack access to multiple APIs and scoring expertise. Packaging this as a service could generate recurring revenue and position Software Factory as a naming authority.
opportunity_driver: New revenue stream from existing automation
Low marginal cost per client audit
Differentiates Software Factory with unique offering
Builds authority in business naming space
Cross-sell opportunity for full app development
dependencies: Pricing model for different audit tiers
Marketing landing page and case studies
Terms of service and legal disclaimers
API key cost management and billing
Customer support workflow for audit questions
next_steps: Validate market demand through customer interviews, estimate API costs at scale, prototype client-facing report format, research competitor pricing (LegalZoom, Trademark Engine)
